## Objective
This is to process human reviewed model output for the fragment model.
Fragments is intended to be a "human-in-the-loop" model with incorrect classificaiton
corrected by a human. 

SOP for reviewing is outline here:
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1YfRRCdEl74Zuk5TyjnUbfgew9tXjFQsAfE5Ay6-rEjA/edit?usp=sharing


## Input
-<subset>_fragments_reviewed.xlsx (fe_si_models/fragments/output/reviewed_fragments)
- images_fragments_reviewed.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/processed_reviewed_fragments)
To keep track -update with each batch

## Output
- fragments_included_<subset>.json
- fragments_exluded_<subset>.json
- images_fragments_reviewed.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/processed_reviewed_fragments)
To keep track -update with each batch
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

process_reviewed_fragments <- function(subset_name, output_dir, fragments_reviewed) {

  fragments_corrected <- fragments_reviewed %>%
    mutate(classification = case_when(!is.na(corrected_classification) ~ corrected_classification,
                                      TRUE ~ classification))

  fragments_included <- fragments_corrected %>%
    filter(is.na(exclude)) %>%
    filter(classification == "original_fragment") %>%
    select(image_name:classification)

  fragments_excluded <- fragments_corrected %>%
    filter(!is.na(exclude) | classification == "duplicate_fragment") %>%
    mutate(exclusion_reason = case_when(classification == "duplicate_fragment" ~ "duplicate_fragment",
                                        TRUE ~ exclusion_reason)) %>%
    select(image_name:classification, exclusion_reason)

  include_path <- paste0(output_dir, "fragments_included_", subset_name, ".json")
  exclude_path <- paste0(output_dir, "fragments_excluded_", subset_name, ".json")
  
  write_json(fragments_included, include_path, pretty = TRUE)
  write_json(fragments_excluded, exclude_path, pretty = TRUE)

 return(list(fragments_included = fragments_included,
             fragments_excluded = fragments_excluded))
}
```


### Process grading_sample (batch_0) (for fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution ...)

```{r}
subset_name <- "grading_sample"

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/"

fragments_reviewed <- read_xlsx(paste0("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/", subset_name, "_fragments_reviewed.xlsx"))

processed <- process_reviewed_fragments(subset_name, output_dir, fragments_reviewed)

images_fragments_reviewed <- unique(fragments_reviewed$image_name)

write_json(images_fragments_reviewed, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/images_fragments_reviewed.json", pretty = TRUE) 
```
